title: 72 Hours
plot_overview: An anxious middle-aged advertising executive joins a much younger group for a chaotic Miami bachelor party after being added to their group chat by mistake. Over 72 hours of escalating mishaps, he tries to keep up while protecting his career and proving he still belongs.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like high-energy comedies, chaotic group dynamics, and childish gross-out humor, but it is Not for you if you prefer subtle jokes, realistic relationships, or quieter character stories.
review_summary: Pros: energetic cast; occasional laughs; fast-moving chaos | Cons: repetitive jokes; gross-out humor; predictable message
